output: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15 in favour to adopt United States draft S/2023/378 as resolution 2682 (2023), unanimously extending the UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI) mandate until 31 May 2024 [VOTE, TERM]. The resolution directs UNAMI to prioritize advice on inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation, ensuring full, equal, and meaningful participation of women, civil society, and youth [SUPPORT]. The Secretary-General is requested to report on UNAMI's fulfilment of responsibilities every four months [REPORT].
